```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()) #set working directory to rproject root
```

#LOAD PACKKAGES
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library('BiocManager') #for installing bioconductor packages like DESeq2
library('DESeq2') #for analyzing differential gene expression
library("mixOmics") #for PCA and PLSDA
library('ggplot2') #for plotting
library("VennDiagram") #for venn diagrams
library("ComplexHeatmap") #for heatmaps
library("viridis") #for gene clustering heatmap colours
library('RColorBrewer') #for sample-sample heatmap colours
library('dendextend') #for editing dendrograms in gene clustering heatmap
library("dplyr") #for data manipulation
library('caret') #for removing zero variance data for PCA/PLSDA
```

#LOAD 2DPI DATA
```{r warning=FALSE}
#Think the way to do DESeq analysis/venn-diagrams is to split into two "experiments" and then compare the two to select primed metabolites
#For PCA and PLS-DA do single experiment (i.e., mock + PM combined) as need to compare all_2dpi treatments 

#MOCK

#read in sample info file
mock_two_dpi_sample_info <- read.table("raw_count/2dpi/mock_sample_info_2dpi.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

#add rownames to sample info = for labelling of plots (e.g., heatmaps)
row.names(mock_two_dpi_sample_info) <- mock_two_dpi_sample_info$sample_name

#create factors for condition column so that water will be used as intercept/base-line/reference for the model
mock_two_dpi_sample_info$condition <- factor(mock_two_dpi_sample_info$condition, levels = c("Mock_Water", "Mock_BABA", "Mock_JA", "Mock_SA"))

#visualize the model matrix that will be used by Deseq2
model.matrix(~condition, data = mock_two_dpi_sample_info)
#should display 4 columns - intercept (MW), MB, MJA, MSA

#read in gene counts data
mock_two_dpi_raw_gene_data <- DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount(
  sampleTable = mock_two_dpi_sample_info, directory = 'raw_count/2dpi',
  design = ~condition)

#PM

#read in sample info file
PM_two_dpi_sample_info <- read.table("raw_count/2dpi/PM_sample_info_2dpi.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

#add rownames to sample info = for labelling of plots (e.g., heatmaps)
row.names(PM_two_dpi_sample_info) <- PM_two_dpi_sample_info$sample_name

#create factors for condition column so that water will be used as intercept/base-line/reference for the model
PM_two_dpi_sample_info$condition <- factor(PM_two_dpi_sample_info$condition, levels = c("PM_Water", "PM_BABA", "PM_JA", "PM_SA"))

#visualize the model matrix that will be used by Deseq2
model.matrix(~condition, data = PM_two_dpi_sample_info)
#should display 4 columns - intercept (MW), MB, MJA, MSA

#read in gene counts data
PM_two_dpi_raw_gene_data <- DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount(
  sampleTable = PM_two_dpi_sample_info, directory = 'raw_count/2dpi',
  design = ~condition)

#ALL DATA (MOCK + PM) 

#read in sample info file
all_two_dpi_sample_info <- read.table("raw_count/2dpi/sample_info_2dpi.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")

#add rownames to sample info = for labelling of plots (e.g., heatmaps)
row.names(all_two_dpi_sample_info) <- all_two_dpi_sample_info$Samplename

#create factors for elicitor column so that water will be used as intercept/base-line
all_two_dpi_sample_info$condition <- factor(all_two_dpi_sample_info$condition, levels = c("Mock_Water", "Mock_BABA", "Mock_JA", "Mock_SA", "PM_Water", "PM_BABA", "PM_JA", "PM_SA"))

#visualize the model matrix that will be used by Deseq2
model.matrix(~condition, data = all_two_dpi_sample_info)

#read in gene counts data
all_two_dpi_raw_gene_data <- DESeqDataSetFromHTSeqCount(
  sampleTable = all_two_dpi_sample_info, directory ='raw_count/2dpi',
  design = ~condition)

```

#TRANSFORMATION
```{r}
rlog_all_two_dpi_raw_gene_data <- rlog(all_two_dpi_raw_gene_data) 
```

#SAMPLE-SAMPLE DISTANCE HEATMAP
```{r}
#Basically shows how similar the different samples are, uses normalised data

#set up pdf to save graphs
sample_clustering_dend <- "Deseq_analysis/two_dpi_out/two_dpi_sample_clustering_dend.pdf"
pdf(file = sample_clustering_dend, width = 10, height = 5)

#first generate sample-sample distance matrix
sampleDistances <- dist(t(assay(rlog_all_two_dpi_raw_gene_data)))
sampleDistMatrix <- as.matrix(sampleDistances)
colnames(sampleDistMatrix) <- rownames(all_two_dpi_sample_info)

#perform hierachical clustering and plot dendrogram
col = c("blue", "blue", "blue", "#117733", "#117733", "#117733", "#44AA99", "#DDCC77", "#DDCC77", "#AA4499", "#AA4499", "#117733", "#33bbee", "#33bbee", "#999933", "#999933", "#999933", "#999933", "#33bbee", "#33bbee", "#44AA99", "#44AA99", "#44AA99", "#882255", "#AA4499", "#882255", "#DDCC77", "#DDCC77", "#AA4499", "#AA4499", "#882255") #set up sample colours
two_dpi_sample_dendrogram <- as.dendrogram(hclust(sampleDistances)) #cluster
dend <- dendextend::set(two_dpi_sample_dendrogram, "labels_colors", col) #color code labels
plot(dend) #plot horizontally
dendextend::rect.dendrogram(dend, h = 90, border = "red", lty = "dashed") #add dashed red rectangles around clusters (visually a cut height of 90 ok)

dev.off()

sample_clustering <- "Deseq_analysis/two_dpi_out/two_dpi_sample_clustering.pdf"
pdf(file = sample_clustering)

#create colour scheme
colours <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(9, "Blues")))(255)

#set up sample annotations for plot
sample_annotations <- all_two_dpi_sample_info[,3]

treatments_top <- HeatmapAnnotation(Condition = sample_annotations, col = list(Condition = c("Mock_Water" = "blue", "Mock_BABA" = "#117733", "Mock_JA" = "#AA4499", "Mock_SA" = "#DDCC77", "PM_Water" = "#33bbee", "PM_BABA" = "#44AA99", "PM_JA" =  "#882255", "PM_SA" = "#999933")), show_annotation_name = F, gp = gpar(col = "black"))

treatments_left <- rowAnnotation(Condition = sample_annotations, col = list(Condition = c("Mock_Water" = "blue", "Mock_BABA" = "#117733", "Mock_JA" = "#AA4499", "Mock_SA" = "#DDCC77", "PM_Water" = "#33bbee", "PM_BABA" = "#44AA99", "PM_JA" =  "#882255", "PM_SA" = "#999933")), show_legend = F, show_annotation_name = F, gp = gpar(col = "black"))

ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(sampleDistMatrix, clustering_distance_rows = sampleDistances, clustering_distance_columns = sampleDistances,
                        col = colours, top_annotation = treatments_top, left_annotation = treatments_left,
                        heatmap_legend_param = list(title = NULL, border = "black"),
                        show_row_names = F, show_column_names = F, column_title = "2dpi Sample Clustering Heatmap")

dev.off()
```

#SET UP PCA AND PLSDA 
```{r}
#extract rlog expression data (unsure if use rlog expression or normal expression)
rlog_expression_all_two_dpi <- t(assay(rlog_all_two_dpi_raw_gene_data))
dim(rlog_expression_all_two_dpi) #check dimensions of resulting matrix

#need to remove colums with all 0s/zero variance as otherwise PLS/PCA will throw error: columns with zero variance in 'X'
all_cols <- colnames(rlog_expression_all_two_dpi) #identify names of all cols 
remove_cols <- caret::nearZeroVar(rlog_expression_all_two_dpi, names = TRUE) #identify cols with zero var to remove 
rlog_expression_all_two_dpi <- rlog_expression_all_two_dpi[ , setdiff(all_cols, remove_cols)] #remove cols with zero var 
dim(rlog_expression_all_two_dpi) #check dimensions of resulting matrix, should be smaller

#extract classes (conditions)
rlog_classes_all_two_dpi <- colData(rlog_all_two_dpi_raw_gene_data)
rlog_classes_all_two_dpi <- rlog_classes_all_two_dpi$condition

#check that all conditions extracted as expected
summary(rlog_classes_all_two_dpi)
```

#PCA SCORES
```{r}
#create PCA model
pca_two_dpi <- pca(rlog_expression_all_two_dpi, ncomp = 14, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

#set up pdf to save graphs
PCA <- "Deseq_analysis/two_dpi_out/two_dpi_PCA_scores_plots.pdf"
pdf(file = PCA)

#plot pca for all samples comps 1 and 2
plotIndiv(pca_two_dpi, comp = c(1,2), group = rlog_classes_all_two_dpi, ind.names = FALSE, 
          ellipse = TRUE, ellipse.level = 0.95, legend = TRUE, title = '2dpi PCA: PC1 vs PC2', 
          col.per.group = c("blue", "#117733", "#AA4499", "#DDCC77", "#33bbee", "#44AA99", "#882255", "#999933"),
          pch = c(19,19,19,19,17,17,17,17), cex = 3, pch.levels = c("mock", "mock", "mock", "mock", "PM", "PM", "PM", "PM"),
          size.xlabel = rel(2), size.ylabel = rel(2), size.axis = rel(1.5))

plotIndiv(
  pca_two_dpi, comp = c(1,3), group = rlog_classes_all_two_dpi, ind.names = FALSE, 
  ellipse = TRUE, ellipse.level = 0.95, legend = TRUE, title = '2dpi PCA: PC1 vs PC3', 
  col.per.group = c("blue", "#117733", "#AA4499", "#DDCC77", "#33bbee", "#44AA99", "#882255", "#999933"), 
  pch = c(19,19,19,19,17,17,17,17), cex = 3, pch.levels = c("mock", "mock", "mock", "mock", "PM", "PM", "PM", "PM"),
  size.xlabel = rel(2), size.ylabel = rel(2), size.axis = rel(1.5)) 

plotIndiv(
  pca_two_dpi, comp = c(2,3), group = rlog_classes_all_two_dpi, ind.names = FALSE, 
  ellipse = TRUE, ellipse.level = 0.95, legend = TRUE, title = '2dpi PCA: PC2 vs PC3', 
  col.per.group = c("blue", "#117733", "#AA4499", "#DDCC77", "#33bbee", "#44AA99", "#882255", "#999933"), 
  pch = c(19,19,19,19,17,17,17,17), cex = 3, pch.levels = c("mock", "mock", "mock", "mock", "PM", "PM", "PM", "PM"),
  size.xlabel = rel(2), size.ylabel = rel(2), size.axis = rel(1.5))

dev.off()
```

#PCA LOADINGS

#PCA SCREE PLOT
```{r}
#set up and plot scree plot
two_dpi_expl_var <- as.data.frame(pca_two_dpi$prop_expl_var) #extract explained variance
names(two_dpi_expl_var)[names(two_dpi_expl_var) == 'X'] <- 'percent_var' #rename percent col
two_dpi_expl_var <- cbind(PC_index = 1:14, two_dpi_expl_var) #add PC_index column
two_dpi_expl_var$percent_var <- two_dpi_expl_var$percent_var * 100 #convert decimal to percent
two_dpi_expl_var$cum_var <- cumsum(two_dpi_expl_var$percent_var) #calculate cumulative variance explained
two_dpi_expl_var$percent_var <- round(two_dpi_expl_var$percent_var, digits = 1) #round to 1dp
two_dpi_expl_var$cum_var <- round(two_dpi_expl_var$cum_var, digits = 1)
two_dpi_expl_var

scree_plot <- ggplot(data = two_dpi_expl_var)+
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = PC_index, y = percent_var))+
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = PC_index, y = percent_var), col = "blue")+
  geom_text(aes(x=PC_index, y=percent_var, label=percent_var), nudge_y = 4)+
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = PC_index, y = cum_var))+
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = PC_index, y = cum_var), col = "#117733")+
  geom_text(aes(x=PC_index, y=cum_var, label=cum_var), nudge_y = 4)+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,15, by = 1))+
  xlab("PC index")+
  ylab("Percentage of variance explained (%)")+
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey"))+
  ggtitle("2dpi Scree Plot")

ggsave(filename = "two_dpi_PCA_scree_plot.pdf", plot = scree_plot, width = 15, height = 9, path = "Deseq_analysis/two_dpi_out", device = "pdf")
```

```{r}
                                    auc = TRUE, #calculate area under the curve performance of model
                                    dist = "all")
```

#SELECT PRIMED DEGs
```{r}
#select significant DEGs mock
sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_BABA_vs_mock_Water <- subset(DEGs_2dpi_mock_BABA_vs_mock_Water, DEGs_2dpi_mock_BABA_vs_mock_Water$padj <= 0.05)
sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_JA_vs_mock_Water <- subset(DEGs_2dpi_mock_JA_vs_mock_Water, DEGs_2dpi_mock_JA_vs_mock_Water$padj <= 0.05)
sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_SA_vs_mock_Water <- subset(DEGs_2dpi_mock_SA_vs_mock_Water, DEGs_2dpi_mock_SA_vs_mock_Water$padj <= 0.05)

print(paste(nrow(sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_BABA_vs_mock_Water), "significant mock BABA DEGs at 2dpi"))
print(paste(nrow(sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_JA_vs_mock_Water), "significant mock JA DEGs at 2dpi"))
print(paste(nrow(sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_SA_vs_mock_Water), "significant mock SA DEGs at 2dpi"))

#select significant DEGs PM
sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_BABA_vs_PM_Water <- subset(DEGs_2dpi_PM_BABA_vs_PM_Water, DEGs_2dpi_PM_BABA_vs_PM_Water$padj <= 0.05)
sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water <- subset(DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water, DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water$padj <= 0.05)
sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water <- subset(DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water, DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water$padj <= 0.05)

print(paste(nrow(sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_BABA_vs_PM_Water), "significant PM BABA DEGs at 2dpi"))
print(paste(nrow(sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water), "significant PM JA DEGs at 2dpi"))
print(paste(nrow(sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water), "significant PM SA DEGs at 2dpi"))

#select row names from mock treatment
BABA_rows_to_remove <- rownames(sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_BABA_vs_mock_Water)
JA_rows_to_remove <- rownames(sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_JA_vs_mock_Water)
SA_rows_to_remove <- rownames(sig_DEGs_2dpi_mock_SA_vs_mock_Water)

#select DEGs only present during infection (i.e., PM DEGs not shared with mock) = primed DEGs
BABA_primed_all_2dpi <- sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_BABA_vs_PM_Water[!rownames(sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_BABA_vs_PM_Water) %in% BABA_rows_to_remove,]
JA_primed_all_2dpi <- sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water[!rownames(sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water) %in% JA_rows_to_remove,]
SA_primed_all_2dpi <- sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water[!rownames(sig_DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water) %in% SA_rows_to_remove,]

print(paste(nrow(BABA_primed_all_2dpi), "total primed BABA DEGs at 2dpi"))
print(paste(nrow(JA_primed_all_2dpi), "total primed JA DEGs at 2dpi"))
print(paste(nrow(SA_primed_all_2dpi), "total primed SA DEGs at 2dpi"))

#select row names for primed DEGs
BABA_primed_rows_to_remove <- rownames(BABA_primed_all_2dpi)
JA_primed_rows_to_remove <- rownames(JA_primed_all_2dpi)
SA_primed_rows_to_remove <- rownames(SA_primed_all_2dpi)

#select primed DEGs exclusive to each treatment
BABA_primed_exclusive_2dpi <- BABA_primed_all_2dpi[!rownames(BABA_primed_all_2dpi) %in% JA_primed_rows_to_remove,]
BABA_primed_exclusive_2dpi <- BABA_primed_exclusive_2dpi[!rownames(BABA_primed_exclusive_2dpi) %in% SA_primed_rows_to_remove,]
JA_primed_exclusive_2dpi <- JA_primed_all_2dpi[!rownames(JA_primed_all_2dpi) %in% BABA_primed_rows_to_remove,]
JA_primed_exclusive_2dpi <- JA_primed_exclusive_2dpi[!rownames(JA_primed_exclusive_2dpi) %in% SA_primed_rows_to_remove,]
SA_primed_exclusive_2dpi <- SA_primed_all_2dpi[!rownames(SA_primed_all_2dpi) %in% BABA_primed_rows_to_remove,]
SA_primed_exclusive_2dpi <- SA_primed_exclusive_2dpi[!rownames(SA_primed_exclusive_2dpi) %in% JA_primed_rows_to_remove,]

print(paste(nrow(BABA_primed_exclusive_2dpi), "BABA exclusive primed DEGs at 2dpi"))
print(paste(nrow(JA_primed_exclusive_2dpi), "JA exclusive primed DEGs at 2dpi"))
print(paste(nrow(SA_primed_exclusive_2dpi), "SA exclusive primed DEGs at 2dpi"))
```

```{r}
DOWN_JA_PM_2dpi <- subset(DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water, DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water$log2FoldChange < -1 & DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water$padj <= 0.05)

DOWN_SA_PM_2dpi <- subset(DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water, DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water$log2FoldChange < -1 & DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water$padj <= 0.05)

#PRIMED UP ALL - FOR VENN
UP_BABA_primed_all_2dpi <- subset(BABA_primed_all_2dpi, BABA_primed_all_2dpi$log2FoldChange > 1 & BABA_primed_all_2dpi$padj <= 0.05)

UP_SA_primed_all_2dpi <- subset(SA_primed_all_2dpi, SA_primed_all_2dpi$log2FoldChange > 1 & SA_primed_all_2dpi$padj <= 0.05) 

#PRIMED DOWN ALL - FOR VENN
DOWN_BABA_primed_all_2dpi <- subset(BABA_primed_all_2dpi, BABA_primed_all_2dpi$log2FoldChange < -1 & BABA_primed_all_2dpi$padj <= 0.05)
```

```{r}
Venn_UP_SA_primed_all_2dpi <- row.names(UP_SA_primed_all_2dpi)
Venn_UP_JA_primed_all_2dpi <- row.names(UP_JA_primed_all_2dpi)

vennPlot <- venn.diagram(list(Venn_UP_SA_primed_all_2dpi, Venn_UP_JA_primed_all_2dpi, Venn_UP_BABA_primed_all_2dpi), filename = NULL, fill=c("#DDCC77", "#AA4499", "#117733"), print.mode = c("raw", "percent"), alpha=c(0.5,0.5,0.5), cex=2.5, category.names = c(" "," ", " "), main = "Upregulated primed genes 2dpi", main.cex = 2, ext.text = TRUE, ext.percent = 0.1, ext.pos = 3, ext.length = 0.7, ext.dist = -0.02)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(vennPlot)

#downregulated genes
Venn_DOWN_BABA_primed_all_2dpi <- row.names(DOWN_BABA_primed_all_2dpi)
Venn_DOWN_SA_primed_all_2dpi <- row.names(DOWN_SA_primed_all_2dpi)
Venn_DOWN_JA_primed_all_2dpi <- row.names(DOWN_JA_primed_all_2dpi)

vennPlot <- venn.diagram(list(Venn_DOWN_SA_primed_all_2dpi, Venn_DOWN_JA_primed_all_2dpi, Venn_DOWN_BABA_primed_all_2dpi), filename = NULL, fill=c("#DDCC77", "#AA4499", "#117733"), print.mode = c("raw", "percent"), alpha=c(0.5,0.5,0.5), cex=2.5, category.names = c(" "," ", " "), main = "Downregulated primed genes 2dpi", main.cex = 2, ext.text = TRUE, ext.percent = 0.1, ext.pos = 3, ext.length = 0.7, ext.dist = -0.02)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(vennPlot)

dev.off()
```

#GENE CLUSTERING HEATMAP
```{r, warning=FALSE}
#set up pdf to save graphs
heatmaps <- "Deseq_analysis/two_dpi_out/two_dpi_heatmaps.pdf"
pdf(file = heatmaps)

#select significant DEGs for BABA mock
significant_BABA_mock_DEGs_heatmap <- DEGs_2dpi_mock_BABA_vs_mock_Water$padj <= 0.05 

sum(significant_BABA_mock_DEGs_heatmap, na.rm = TRUE) #check number = same as before

#select significant DEGs for SA mock
significant_SA_mock_DEGs_heatmap <- DEGs_2dpi_mock_SA_vs_mock_Water$padj <= 0.05 

sum(significant_SA_mock_DEGs_heatmap, na.rm = TRUE) #check number = same as before

#select significant DEGs for JA mock
significant_JA_mock_DEGs_heatmap <- DEGs_2dpi_mock_JA_vs_mock_Water$padj <= 0.05 

sum(significant_JA_mock_DEGs_heatmap, na.rm = TRUE) #check number = same as before

#select significant DEGs for BABA PM
significant_BABA_PM_DEGs_heatmap <- DEGs_2dpi_PM_BABA_vs_PM_Water$padj <= 0.05 

sum(significant_BABA_PM_DEGs_heatmap, na.rm = TRUE) #check number = same as before

#select significant DEGs for SA PM
significant_SA_PM_DEGs_heatmap <- DEGs_2dpi_PM_SA_vs_PM_Water$padj <= 0.05 

sum(significant_SA_PM_DEGs_heatmap, na.rm = TRUE) #check number = same as before

#select significant DEGs for JA PM
significant_JA_PM_DEGs_heatmap <- DEGs_2dpi_PM_JA_vs_PM_Water$padj <= 0.05 

sum(significant_JA_PM_DEGs_heatmap, na.rm = TRUE) #check number = same as before

#combine significant DEGs into single vector = merges duplicates
significant_all_DEGs_heatmap <- base::Reduce('|', list(significant_BABA_mock_DEGs_heatmap, significant_SA_mock_DEGs_heatmap, significant_JA_mock_DEGs_heatmap, significant_BABA_PM_DEGs_heatmap, significant_SA_PM_DEGs_heatmap, significant_JA_PM_DEGs_heatmap))

sum(significant_all_DEGs_heatmap, na.rm = TRUE) #check number

#create df
heatmap_df <- data.frame(assay(rlog_all_two_dpi_raw_gene_data)[which(significant_all_DEGs_heatmap),])

#remove rows containing all zeros
heatmap_df[heatmap_df==0] <- NA #convert 0 to NAs
heatmap_df <- na.omit(heatmap_df) #remove NAs

#calculate mean
m = apply(heatmap_df, 1, mean, na.rm = T)

#calculate sd
sd = apply(heatmap_df, 1, sd, na.rm = T)

#scale
scaled_heatmap_df <- (heatmap_df - m)/sd

# #note scaling is based on the scale_rows function within pheatmap which performs the following 
# scale_rows = function(x){
#     m = apply(x, 1, mean, na.rm = T)
#     s = apply(x, 1, sd, na.rm = T)
#     return((x - m) / s)}

#set up gene clustering dendrogram
gene_dend <- as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(scaled_heatmap_df))) 
#dist calculates distances using euclidean distances as default 
#hclust performs hierarchical clustering using the complete linkage method by default

gene_dend #height = 10.83969 

#try different heights to cut tree to find optimal number of clusters to colour code
gene_dend1 <- color_branches(gene_dend, h=10.8, col = brewer.pal(8,"Dark2"))
plot(gene_dend1, main = "cut height 10.8") #2 clusters = too few

#based on initial plot somewhere around 10.5 looks best
gene_dend2 <- color_branches(gene_dend, h=10.5, col = brewer.pal(8,"Dark2"))
plot(gene_dend2, main = "cut height 10.5") #8 clusters = looks about right

gene_dend3 <- color_branches(gene_dend, h=10.4, col = brewer.pal(8,"Dark2"))
plot(gene_dend3, main = "cut height 10.4") #10 clusters = probably too many

gene_dend4 <- color_branches(gene_dend, h=10.45, col = brewer.pal(8,"Dark2"))
plot(gene_dend4, main = "cut height 10.45") #8 clusters = looks about right

#save optimal number of clusters as k, 10.45 looks good
cut <- cutree(gene_dend, h=10.45)
k <- as.numeric(max(levels(as.factor(cut))))

#set up sample annotations for plots
sample_annotations <- all_two_dpi_sample_info[,3]
conditions <- HeatmapAnnotation(Condition = sample_annotations, col = list(Condition = c("Mock_Water" = "blue", "Mock_BABA" = "#117733", "Mock_JA" = "#AA4499", "Mock_SA" = "#DDCC77", "PM_Water" = "#33bbee", "PM_BABA" = "#44AA99", "PM_JA" =  "#882255", "PM_SA" = "#999933")), gp = gpar(col = "black"))

#set up column split to separate mock and infected in plots
column_split = rep("Mock", 31)
column_split[17:31] = "PM"

#plot heatmap
htmp1 <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(scaled_heatmap_df, cluster_columns = FALSE, 
                                 cluster_rows = gene_dend4, #use optimal cluster dendrogram for colour coding
                                 split = k, #split up dendrogram to number clusters
                                 col = viridis(7), show_row_names = FALSE, 
                                 heatmap_legend_param = list(title = NULL, direction = "horizontal", at = c(-5,-2.5,0,2.5,5)),
                                 top_annotation = conditions, show_column_names = FALSE, column_split = column_split)

draw(htmp1, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")

dev.off()
```

#SAVE BABA DATA FOR INTEGRATION
```{r}
#EXTRACT COUNTS FOR 2DPI

#select counts data
counts_2dpi <- as.data.frame(counts(all_two_dpi_raw_gene_data)) 

#add column of gene names
counts_2dpi <- cbind(gene = row.names(counts_2dpi), counts_2dpi) 

#save counts data
write.csv(counts_2dpi, 
          file = "Deseq_analysis/two_dpi_out/gene_counts_2dpi.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)


#SELECT GENES EXCLUSIVE TO BABA PRIMING
BABA_primed_2dpi <- data.frame(gene = rownames(BABA_primed_exclusive_2dpi)) 

#LOAD COUNTS DATA FOR 0 AND 1DPI

#load 0dpi counts
counts_0dpi <- read.csv(file = "Deseq_analysis/zero_dpi_out/gene_counts_0dpi.csv")

#load 1dpi counts
counts_1dpi <- read.csv(file = "Deseq_analysis/one_dpi_out/gene_counts_1dpi.csv")

#FILTER NON-PRIMED GENES FROM COUNTS DATA
#here we select only genes in gene_counts data that are exclusive to BABA priming at 2dpi

#0dpi
BABA_primed_counts_0dpi <- subset(counts_0dpi, gene %in% BABA_primed_2dpi$gene) 

#1dpi
BABA_primed_counts_1dpi <- subset(counts_1dpi, gene %in% BABA_primed_2dpi$gene) 

#2dpi
BABA_primed_counts_2dpi <- subset(counts_2dpi, gene %in% BABA_primed_2dpi$gene) 

#MERGE, PREP AND SAVE FINAL TABLE
#note done starting with 2dpi so columns in time order in final df

#append 2dpi gene counts to BABA primed 2dpi gene names
BABA_primed_gene_names_and_counts_2dpi <- as.data.frame(append(BABA_primed_counts_2dpi, BABA_primed_2dpi))

#append 1dpi gene counts to BABA primed 2dpi gene names
BABA_primed_gene_names_and_counts_2dpi <- as.data.frame(append(BABA_primed_counts_1dpi, BABA_primed_gene_names_and_counts_2dpi))

#append 0dpi gene counts to BABA primed 2dpi gene names
BABA_primed_gene_names_and_counts_2dpi <- as.data.frame(append(BABA_primed_counts_0dpi, BABA_primed_gene_names_and_counts_2dpi)) 

#remove gene name columns added from gene_counts
BABA_primed_gene_names_and_counts_2dpi <- subset(BABA_primed_gene_names_and_counts_2dpi, select = c(-17, -49, -81))

#save final df as csv
write.csv(BABA_primed_gene_names_and_counts_2dpi, file = "Deseq_analysis/two_dpi_out/BABA_primed_genes_2dpi_counts.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
